item.title: The genocide in Gaza has not stopped: pain advances at times drop by drop and at others like an unstoppable tsunami
item.description: There are days when death in Gaza seems to advance in silence, one life today, another tomorrow, as if horror were administered in small doses so as not to disturb the world’s conscience too much. And there are other days… Claudia Aranda

item.title: Mariano Barbacid: when science advances generously and in silence while noise occupies the world
item.description: There are news stories that do not arrive wrapped in epic narratives, nor in strident promises, nor in headlines designed to excite hope. They arrive in silence, as important things usually do. While the public space becomes saturated with shouting,… Claudia Aranda

item.title: Contemporary slavery: structure, power, and the production of exploitable lives in the current global order
item.description: This journalistic essay examines contemporary slavery as a structural regime of the current global order rather than as a residual anomaly, a marginal criminal deviation, or an isolated humanitarian problem. Drawing on a critical review of the literature in political… Claudia Aranda
